title.en: How I got used to it

es: Escribir un relato de adaptación (80–100 palabras) contrastando hábitos pasados, costumbres actuales y cambios en proceso.

teaching.en: I used to live in a small town, and I knew all my neighbours.
teaching.es: Antes vivía en una ciudad pequeña y conocía a todos mis vecinos.
teaching.explanationEs: Used to + verbo base abre el relato: cómo era la vida antes.
segments: I used to live in a small
town, and I knew all my neighbours.
teaching.audioText: I used to live in a small town, and I knew all my neighbours.

teaching.en: At first I wasn't used to the crowded metro, and I got lost twice.
teaching.es: Al principio no estaba acostumbrado al metro lleno y me perdí dos veces.
teaching.explanationEs: Wasn't used to + nombre cuenta lo que costaba al llegar.
segments: At first I wasn't used to the
crowded metro, and I got lost twice.
teaching.audioText: At first I wasn't used to the crowded metro, and I got lost twice.

teaching.en: Gradually, I got used to the noise and the crowds.
teaching.es: Poco a poco me acostumbré al ruido y a las multitudes.
teaching.explanationEs: Got used to cuenta el proceso que terminó; gradually marca que fue poco a poco.
teaching.audioText: Gradually, I got used to the noise and the crowds.

teaching.en: Now I'm used to the crowds, but I'm still getting used to cooking for myself.
teaching.es: Ahora estoy acostumbrado a las multitudes, pero todavía me estoy acostumbrando a cocinar para mí.
teaching.explanationEs: Am used to + -ing es lo habitual hoy; am still getting used to es lo que sigue en proceso.
segments: Now I'm used to the crowds, but I'm
still getting used to cooking for myself.
teaching.audioText: Now I'm used to the crowds, but I'm still getting used to cooking for myself.

teaching.en: Looking back, I'm proud of myself, because it wasn't easy.
teaching.es: Mirando atrás, estoy orgulloso de mí, porque no fue fácil.
teaching.explanationEs: Un cierre con presente y causa (because) da sentido al relato.
teaching.audioText: Looking back, I'm proud of myself, because it wasn't easy.

prompt.es: Según las notas, ¿qué frase cuenta cómo era la vida antes?

choices.text: I used to live in a small town.
I'm used to living in a small town.
I'm getting used to a small town.

feedback.es: Antes y ya no: used to + verbo base. Las otras opciones hablan de lo que es normal hoy o de un proceso.

hint.es: Antes y ya no: necesitas la forma que va con un verbo base.

origin.text: Notes: Before: small town, knew all the neighbours. Now: big city.

prompt.es: Completa: «Poco a poco me acostumbré al ruido.»

feedback.es: Un proceso terminado en el pasado se dice got used to; también son correctos became y grew used to.

hint.es: Es un proceso terminado: necesitas el verbo get en pasado.

origin.text: Gradually, I ___ used to the noise.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ahora estoy acostumbrado a trabajar hasta tarde.»

feedback.es: Hoy ya es normal, así que se usa be used to + -ing: working.

hint.es: Hoy ya es normal: detrás de used to va un verbo con -ing.

prompt.es: Ordena: «No estaba acostumbrada al autobús lleno.»

answer.text: She wasn't used to the crowded bus

feedback.es: Wasn't used to + nombre cuenta lo que no era normal al empezar: she wasn't used to the crowded bus.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué dice el hablante sobre su vida anterior.

choices.text: He lived in the mountains.
He lived near the coast.
He lived in another big city.

feedback.es: Used to live near the sea es el pasado: vivía cerca de la costa.

origin.audio: I used to live near the sea, so I wasn't used to the big city at first.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cuenta un proceso todavía abierto?

choices.text: I got used to cooking alone.
I used to cook alone.
I'm still getting used to cooking alone.

feedback.es: Still + am getting used to indica que el proceso no ha terminado; got used to ya terminó y used to es pasado.

prompt.es: Según el diario, ¿qué frase resume la semana 10?

choices.text: I'm used to the city now.
I'm getting used to the city.
I wasn't used to the city.

feedback.es: En la semana 10 no hay problema: el proceso terminó y ya es normal, am used to.

origin.text: Diary: 'Week 1: I got lost. Week 5: fewer mistakes. Week 10: no problem!'

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ha cambiado en las mañanas del hablante.

choices.text: He still needs two alarms.
He gets up early without help.
He now gets up at noon.

feedback.es: Now I do it without an alarm significa que se levanta temprano sin ayuda: ya se acostumbró.

origin.audio: When I started my new job, I wasn't used to getting up at six. Now I do it without an alarm.

prompt.es: Cuenta cómo te adaptaste a la ciudad con los datos dados (70–110 palabras).

answer.text: I used to live in a small town, and I knew all my neighbours. When I moved to a big city last year, I wasn't used to the crowded metro, and I got lost twice in my first week. I felt lonely at first, but my friends helped me a lot. Gradually, I got used to the noise and the crowds. Now I'm used to working late, but I'm still getting used to cooking for myself. Looking back, I'm proud of myself, because it wasn't easy.
accepted: I used to live in a small town, and I knew all my neighbours. When I moved to a big city last year, I wasn't used to the crowded metro, and I got lost twice in my first week. I felt lonely at first, but my friends helped me a lot. Gradually, I got used to the noise and the crowds. Now I'm used to working late, but I'm still getting used to cooking for myself. Looking back, I'm proud of myself, because it wasn't easy.

I used to live in a small town, where I knew all my neighbours. When I moved to a big city last year, I wasn't used to the crowded metro, and I got lost twice during my first week. At first I felt lonely, but my friends helped me a lot. Little by little, I got used to the noise and the crowds. Now I am used to working late, but I am still getting used to cooking for myself. I am proud of myself because it wasn't easy.

Before, I used to live in a small town and I knew all my neighbours. Last year I moved to a big city. I wasn't used to the crowded metro, and I got lost twice in the first week. I felt lonely at first, but my friends helped me a lot. Gradually I got used to the noise and the crowds. Now I'm used to working late, and I'm still getting used to cooking for myself. I'm proud of myself, because it wasn't easy.

feedback.es: El relato necesita used to + verbo (antes), wasn't used to (al principio), got used to (proceso) y am used to / am getting used to (hoy).

origin.text: Datos: antes vivías en un pueblo pequeño y conocías a todos tus vecinos. Al mudarte a una ciudad grande el año pasado no estabas acostumbrado al metro lleno y te perdiste dos veces en la primera semana. Al principio te sentías solo, pero tus amigos te ayudaron. Poco a poco te acostumbraste al ruido y a la gente. Ahora estás acostumbrado a trabajar hasta tarde, pero todavía te estás acostumbrando a cocinar para ti. Estás orgulloso, porque no fue fácil.

evidenceGroups: I am still getting used to

prompt.es: Completa: «Antes conocía a todos mis vecinos.»

feedback.es: Un estado del pasado que ya no existe se dice used to + verbo base: used to know.

origin.text: I ___ to know all my neighbours.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión corrige el primer error del borrador?

choices.text: I'm used to live in a town. Now I'm used to living in the city.
I used to living in a town. Now I'm used to live in the city.
I used to live in a town. Now I'm used to living in the city.

feedback.es: El pasado que ya no existe es used to + verbo base (live); lo de hoy es be used to + -ing (living).

origin.text: Draft: 'I used to living in a town. Now I'm used to living in the city.'

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuánto tardó el hablante en adaptarse.

choices.text: Twelve months.
Three months.
One week.

feedback.es: A whole year equivale a doce meses: ese fue el tiempo que tardó en acostumbrarse.

origin.audio: It took me a whole year to get used to my new school, but I'm proud of it.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Ella todavía se está acostumbrando a trabajar de noche.»

answer.text: She is still getting used to working at night

feedback.es: Is still getting used to + -ing cuenta un proceso abierto; working lleva -ing.
